title: The Shortest-Splitline Algorithm: a Gerrymandering Solution [Bonus Video]
summary: A short CGP Grey bonus video explaining the shortest-splitline algorithm, which draws electoral districts by repeatedly splitting a state along its shortest dividing line while balancing population. It is offered as a neutral, algorithmic fix for gerrymandering.
why: Cited as the standard example of algorithmic redistricting when gerrymandering and electoral reform come up.

quote.text: See for example the Shortest Splitline Algorithm
